description:
A solar PV installation is reporting negative power values because the Current Transformer (CT) sensor was installed backwards. Correct this in software without losing the data connection.

Target Input: Node 'garage_solar', Input 'power'.

Goal:
1. Configure the input processing for 'garage_solar:power' to invert the polarity (multiply by -1) so values become positive.
2. Log the corrected real-time power to a new PHPFina feed named 'solar_yield' (10s interval).
3. Log the cumulative energy to a new PHPFina feed named 'solar_energy' (10s interval) using the 'Power to kWh' processor.

Ensure the processing order is correct: Scale -> Log -> Accumulate.
